sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Tigr Safari is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Okay, here's the next deal. Russia kindly supplied the UN peacekeeping mission with several Tigr vehicles. The mission has now been almost completely withdrawn, and those vehicles have been left sitting idle. I need you to find any one of them on Customs and mark it with a beacon. There are still plenty of valuable components left inside that can be removed and sold to American intelligence. I suggest searching along the main road. Unfortunately, I do not have any beacons available at the moment, so you will have to sort that out yourself."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - This quest is only obtainable by USEC PMCs.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Locate and mark any UN Tigr vehicle with an MS2000 Marker on Customs

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +3,000 EXP
- Peacekeeper Rep +0.1
- 550 Dollars
  - 578 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 632 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
"I trust you did not discuss this operation with the local authorities? Great. Here is your reward."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| MS2000 Marker | 1 | Required | N/A | This item is placed on the armored cars. When placed, you must stay alive until the timer finishes or it will need to be replaced. |

MS2000 Markers can be bought from Prapor or Ragman.

sections.heading: See Also
sections.text: - Scrap Metal - The BEAR counterpart quest

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
- You can buy MS2000 Markers from Prapor or Ragman if needed.
- It is recommended that the player keeps the MS2000 Markers in their special slots or pouch so they are not lost in the event of their death.
- The MS2000 Markers will automatically be used out of the players' inventory when needed, similar to how keys work
